blocks.text: Dr. Chandrashekhar Chauhan obtained his B. Sc. (Computer Science) degree in 2004 and M.Sc. (Mathematics) degree in 2006 from Govt. (Autonomous) Holkar Science College, Indore. He has completed Ph.D. in Mathematics (Fixed-point theory) from Devi Ahilya University, Indore (M.P.)-India in 2018. He has also qualified Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (Mathematics)-2007 and State Eligibility Test-2018 for Assistant Professor. He joined the Institute of Engineering & Technology, Devi Ahilya University, Indore (M.P.)-India as a Lecturer in 2007 and became Sr. Lecturer in 2013 and then Assistant Professor in 2018 and Associate Professor in 2021. Dr. Chauhan’s research interest include Fixed Pint Theory and the Mathematical modelling. He has supervised two Ph. D. and Three M.Sc. students so far and Three Ph. D students are registered. He has published more then thirty research papers in peer-reviewed national and international reputed journals including SCI, WEB OF SCIENCE, SCOPUS and UGC CARE . He has also written one subject book and two edited book. He has attended various seminars/conferences/workshop/FDP. He is life member of two academic societies. He has been teaching Mathematics to UG and PG students for more than eighteen years.
